newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Green buys UK commerical property portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Green buys UK commerical property portfolio.

text.p: Green Property Plc said on Thursday that it has acquired a mixed commercial portfolio in Britian from Morgan Grenfell Property Asset Management (MGPAM) for 68.5 million sterling.
The portfolio of 11 properties currently produces a rental income of 5.41 million stg representing an initial yield of 7.8 percent, Green said in a statement.
The acquisition, which is subject to shareholder approval, will be financed by a seven-year term loan and from Green's internal resources, the company said.

"This particular group of properties, comprising approximately two million square feet of commercial real estate, gives us a number of very interesting opportunites for active management, trading and development," Green managing director Stephen Vernon said.
He said the transaction represented another significant move for Green in Britain.

More than 80 percent of the value of the portfolio is represented by four principal properties -- an office building in London's West End, a retail and residential estate in Kensington and industrial estate in Watford and Treforest near Cardiff, Green said.
